create.name: Carol Wetherill
create.bio:
Carol Wetherill is a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner who teaches both the Level 1 and Level 4 workshops, working through her practice Intrinsic You from Columbia, Maryland. She spent close to three decades in energy and bodywork before Quantum-Touch, which she found drew together its breath, touch, love and intention in a simple way that she wanted to pass on. Her approach rests on the idea that healing comes from within and that a practitioner's part is to hold a steady, heart-centred field of energy for the other person's own process.

She gives individual Quantum-Touch sessions in person or over Zoom, opening with a conversation about the client's intentions, then offering energy while the client rests, and ending with time to talk over whatever came up; a short free introductory session is available. She teaches Becoming Energized (Level 1) and Becoming Heart Conscious (Level 4) as live online classes, over a weekend or spread across shorter weekday sessions, and helps run free weekly healing circles on Zoom for anyone who has completed Level 1, opening with a chakra meditation. Alongside Quantum-Touch, Intrinsic You offers wellness coaching, spiritual care, yoga and breathwork, and bodywork.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch sessions
courses.description: Private sessions in person or on Zoom: a short talk about your intention, a period of rest while Carol offers Quantum-Touch energy, and time afterwards to reflect on what arose. Single sessions or packages; a free mini session is offered to newcomers.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 4: Becoming Heart Conscious (2-day virtual class)
courses.description: A live online class for those who have taken Level 1, focused on connecting more deeply with the heart and using heart energy with any part of the body. Held over a weekend; a four-part weekday version runs in early December.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1: Becoming Energized (2-day virtual class)
courses.description: The foundation Quantum-Touch workshop, taught live online. Students learn to build and focus life-force energy and to use hands-on and distance techniques for themselves, family and friends; it is the prerequisite for all later levels.

free_resources.title: Quantum-Touch community circles
free_resources.description: Free group practice on Zoom for Quantum-Touch students: a Sunday healing circle for anyone who has done Level 1, opening with a chakra meditation before partners exchange energy, and a Wednesday morning guided practice that Carol is starting.
